text:
Harper: heads-up - demo produced a tiny burst where ingress blocked on admission and we returned a flurry of 503s. Need a nonblocking contract at the gateway.
Zoe: paste of the short trace:
```
2026-08-11T14:02:09Z ingress-gw WARN req=aa7 hold=admission wait=980ms
2026-08-11T14:02:09Z admission ERR req=aa7 reconcile=slow
2026-08-11T14:02:09Z ingress-gw ERR req=aa7 respond=503
```
Harper: gateway was synchronously waiting on a long lease reconcile. Two high-level options: early-fast-fail, or "speculative admit" where gw accepts a short-lived speculative permit and admission reconciles later.
Rohan: "Speculative admit" wording is new to our repo but basically the same as provisional/grace. Pros: keeps p99 low for clients. Cons: adds accounting, revocation and fairness complexity.
Chen: sketch proto (compact):
```
message SpecAdmitDecision {
  enum Kind { APPROVE=0; SPECULATIVE=1; DENY=2 }
  Kind kind = 1;
  string token_id = 2;
  int32 speculative_ttl_ms = 3; // only for SPECULATIVE
  string fallback_route = 4;
}
```
Diego: runtime behavior ideas: if SPECULATIVE -> gw lets request through but tags it speculative=true and routes to a deprioritized queue so confirmed grants can preempt. gw stores token_id in a tiny in-memory cache (key=tenant:route) ttl~600ms to avoid stampedes.
Zoe: billing policy options: charge-on-issue then refund on revoke (simpler billing + discourages abuse) vs delay-charge-until-confirm (more accurate but complex). I lean to charge-on-issue with auditable refunds.
Rohan: reconciliation semantics: admission will emit Confirm(token_id) or Revoke(token_id). On Revoke we increment speculative_revoked counter, enqueue a refund/audit event and tighten the tenant's speculative allowance. We should NOT try to retroactively stop already-responded work.
Chen: telemetry we need: speculative_issued, speculative_revoked, speculative_revoked_rate, speculative_ttl_hist, reconcile_refunds_total. Tag by tenant, route, priority_class. Alert if revoked_rate > 0.5% over 5m.
Harper: safety gating: only enable SPECULATIVE for low-cost routes (embeddings, short completions) initially. Add per-tenant cap (speculative_qps_limit) and global rate.
Diego: canary plan: local sim harness -> staging smoke -> 1% prod for 24h -> 5% prod for 48h if metrics healthy. Also run fairness sims with bursty patterns before rollout.
Harper: next steps: Harper -> write RFC + proto, Diego -> gateway sketch + cache, Chen -> reconciliation + refund flow, Zoe -> telemetry/alerts, Rohan -> simulator. I'll open RFC and tag owners. :thumbsup:
